language.name: Kestrel Matchday
language.rationale: A high-octane matchday identity combining sharp, high-contrast Carbon surfaces with an electric Volt edge-bar. Heavy condensed typography and fast snap transitions project instant authority and kinetic football broadcast energy.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (compact density - 18/25px padding, 8px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a bar fused to the panel's leading edge, outside its padding
motion: snap at fast pace → preset slide-up
